claim: Post-1995 Okinawan mobilization combines ecology, peace, women, human-rights, and material/class agendas
current_project_evidence: Actor–issue and episode layers represent several of these agendas
permissible_current_wording: Existing research has established movement diversification; the database can trace its organizational carriers
prohibited_inference: The database discovered issue diversification
next_data_or_test: Build temporal actor–issue and person–organization histories

claim: Quotidian disruptions and locally resonant frames can broaden base-related mobilization
current_project_evidence: Sakishima, referendum, environmental, noise, and life-safety episodes
permissible_current_wording: Everyday harms are established mobilizing frames; compare who carries each frame and where it enters institutions
prohibited_inference: Every local frame is strategically invented by NGOs or has the same effect
next_data_or_test: Compare positive, failed, and non-entry episodes

claim: Movement networks matter, but alliance-security consensus and state institutions constrain outcomes
current_project_evidence: Six reviewed legal/policy cases and 13 translation episodes
permissible_current_wording: Institutional entry can produce intermediate outcomes without changing the military project
prohibited_inference: Network structure alone causes success or failure
next_data_or_test: Code outcome ladders and competing institutional explanations

claim: Family support, labor, migration, marriage, service, and community contact help reproduce the everyday base society
current_project_evidence: Nine service/charity actors and initial service/donation/recipient records
permissible_current_wording: The current organization layer observes part of garrison reproduction
prohibited_inference: NGOs alone reproduce the entire garrison or all participants support the base politically
next_data_or_test: Mark labor, family, and private relations as contextual or future layers

claim: Environmental symbols and international institutions can carry Okinawa disputes beyond local venues, often producing partial or intermediate results
current_project_evidence: Dugong pathway, legal roles, and translation episodes
permissible_current_wording: Internationalization can be reconstructed as actor-role-venue-output sequences
prohibited_inference: International entry necessarily stops a project or represents durable alliance
next_data_or_test: Add Yambaru/UNESCO episode and compare outputs

claim: Contact and economic benefits are plausible attitude mechanisms across host states, but Okinawa-specific evidence does not show automatic local acceptance
current_project_evidence: Service and benefit infrastructure can be measured; attitudes cannot
permissible_current_wording: Service/contact may be a legitimation pathway; its effect remains an empirical question
prohibited_inference: A donation, service, or contact event proves legitimacy for U.S. presence
next_data_or_test: Collect recipient response, media framing, and survey/interview evidence

claim: Okinawans may endorse dominant and resistance narratives simultaneously
current_project_evidence: Current database contains organizations and public actions, not individual narrative profiles
permissible_current_wording: Political meaning may be mixed and ambivalent
prohibited_inference: Every actor or participant can be assigned a single pro-/anti-US position
next_data_or_test: Add discourse and audience-response evidence only at the appropriate unit

claim: U.S. authorities have historically treated Okinawan attitudes and narratives as objects of public diplomacy and analysis
current_project_evidence: X013 and public-diplomacy leads exist, but named awards and effects remain incomplete
permissible_current_wording: Public diplomacy is a historically documented governance strategy
prohibited_inference: Every U.S.-linked NGO is an instrument of psychological operations
next_data_or_test: Crosswalk NOFO, award, recipient, program, contract, and public narrative records

claim: The current registry contains 17 U.S.-origin actors, including a nine-actor service/charity comparison subset and six U.S.-origin accountability actors
current_project_evidence: 121 active actors and the documented comparison sets
permissible_current_wording: The v1 database distinguishes two analytically useful U.S.-linked subsets
prohibited_inference: All U.S.-related civil organizations have been enumerated or fit one of two camps
next_data_or_test: Complete official-site directory and MCCS/private-organization universe

claim: Current bounded typed-dyadic, event, and R10 inputs encode no direct organization relation between the nine service actors and the 77-actor accountability comparison set
academic_support: L018 as method caution; post-freeze H2 overlay
current_project_evidence: 0/0/0 direct cross-group organization edges in the specified inputs
permissible_current_wording: No direct cross-group organization edge is encoded in the bounded current inputs
prohibited_inference: The two social worlds have no shared people, recipients, informal ties, or real-world relationships
next_data_or_test: Build public person-role and full recipient networks; report missingness

claim: The database contains source-backed examples of umbrella affiliation, donations, sponsorship, service provision, and local recipients around the garrison
current_project_evidence: AWWA/spouse-club affiliation, OESC–USO donation, USO sponsors, and selected recipient relations
permissible_current_wording: These relations show organizational infrastructure for service and community mediation
prohibited_inference: The relations prove political support, donor control, or legitimacy effects
next_data_or_test: Complete years, amounts, purposes, recipient acknowledgements, and source types

claim: Reviewed case and episode tables can distinguish parties, counsel, supporters, venues, outputs, and substantive project change
current_project_evidence: Six reviewed cases, 27 roles, and 13 translation episodes
permissible_current_wording: The project can compare institutional entry and intermediate outcomes at role level
prohibited_inference: Every participating organization is an ally, plaintiff, or effective veto player
next_data_or_test: Normalize outcome ladder and add non-entry controls

claim: The observed actor–issue perimeter is highly dependent on a small source cluster
current_project_evidence: Post-freeze H1 source-deletion result; S004 dominates three-source loss
permissible_current_wording: Current encoded visibility and graph shape are source-dependent
prohibited_inference: High observed centrality equals high real-world influence
next_data_or_test: Run source-deletion, no-website, and identity-uncertainty sensitivity for every network layer

claim: A typed temporal multilayer network can connect accountability and garrison reproduction without collapsing relation semantics
current_project_evidence: Planned person, resource, service, case/action, and affiliation layers
permissible_current_wording: Candidate contribution: compare mechanisms and cross-layer brokerage in one locality
prohibited_inference: All relation types can be projected into one alliance or influence graph
next_data_or_test: Build five separate layers and allow only time-overlapping, reviewed projections

claim: Constraint, reproduction, mediation, public diplomacy, and legitimation should be coded at action/relation level rather than assigned as permanent actor identities
current_project_evidence: Existing organizations can hold different roles across cases and times
permissible_current_wording: Candidate contribution: mechanism-based classification with mixed and changing positions
prohibited_inference: An organization is inherently pro-base or anti-base based on one event
next_data_or_test: Create action-effect vocabulary with valid-time and case scope

claim: Legitimation can be tested as a chain from public claim to resource/service delivery to audience response and attitude/policy effect
current_project_evidence: Claim and service records exist; response/effect data are thin
permissible_current_wording: Candidate contribution: separate and link legitimation claims, delivery, reception, and effects
prohibited_inference: Observed goodwill language or charitable transfer proves social acceptance
next_data_or_test: Collect paired claim, recipient, media, survey/interview, and policy-response records

claim: Institutional accountability episodes can be compared using an outcome ladder rather than a binary success measure
current_project_evidence: Six cases and 13 episodes already distinguish venue entry and project change
permissible_current_wording: Candidate contribution: compare disclosure, review, recognition, compensation, delay, costs, and project change across venues
prohibited_inference: Compensation or a formal record equals project constraint, or failure to stop a project equals no effect
next_data_or_test: Review episode facts and add duration/cost/outcome evidence

claim: Shared people, leadership succession, tenure overlap, and cross-side brokerage are not systematically measured
current_project_evidence: Only partial public person-role observations
permissible_current_wording: People-network claims remain open
prohibited_inference: No shared people exist between service and accountability actors
next_data_or_test: Build person→organization→role→start/end→source table with privacy rule

claim: Complete donor, sponsor, award, amount, purpose, year, and recipient histories are missing
current_project_evidence: Selected AWWA, spouse-club, USO, and recipient observations only
permissible_current_wording: Current records are examples, not a complete resource network
prohibited_inference: Who funds whom, donor control, or recipient dependence is already known
next_data_or_test: Retrieve Form 990s, annual reports, award/contract records, sponsor lists, and recipient acknowledgements

claim: Recipient attitudes, public response, and policy-support effects are mostly unmeasured
current_project_evidence: No project survey or systematic recipient-response corpus
permissible_current_wording: The effect of service on legitimacy remains untested
prohibited_inference: Service, donation, or contact created consent
next_data_or_test: Use existing surveys as prior evidence; design interviews, surveys, or before/after discourse measures

claim: Pre-2012 organization continuity, ephemeral committees, non-entry cases, and organizations without durable web presence are under-observed
current_project_evidence: Local-retrieval ledger and source-visibility audit
permissible_current_wording: Historical and low-visibility sectors remain incomplete
prohibited_inference: Post-1972 organizational evolution can be inferred from current websites
next_data_or_test: Retrieve local newspapers, newsletters, minutes, flyers, directories, and archived reports
